text: Entry 1508 is a human integration change, not an automated bulk exclusion. It ports many DevTools defaults but explicitly keeps show-content-scripts true to ease extension debugging even though Firefox then defaulted false. Current preference/comment retain that exception. Proposed porting rule for this preferences section: keep justified Thunderbird overrides visible with their purpose instead of treating an upstream sync as byte equality. Other current Firefox defaults were not independently checked. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.
title: Sync upstream DevTools defaults while documenting intentional Thunderbird exceptions
